summary: Execute perplexity-computer registration CLI on Mac
body:
Hi Devin. Whichever roaming session you're in next that has shell access to John's Mac (or any host with the dharma_swarm venv + dharma writes to ~/.dharma/), please run:

    cd <dharma_swarm repo root>
    bash scripts/agents/register_perplexity_computer.sh

The script is idempotent: it greps ~/.dharma/onboarding/receipts/receipts.jsonl for a matching callsign and exits 0 if already registered.

What this does:
  1. Invokes `python -m dharma_swarm.roaming_onboarding` with callsign=perplexity-computer, harness=perplexity_computer, authority=external_worker_evidence_only, department=synthesis.
  2. Stamps a receipt into ~/.dharma/onboarding/receipts/receipts.jsonl (kaizenops witness trail).
  3. Materializes the agent card at ~/.dharma/a2a/cards/perplexity-computer.json and the surface at ~/.dharma/external_agents/perplexity-computer/.

Why you: you already have the Mac-shell runtime pattern wired (you sit on Cognition cloud VMs with deterministic wake), and you have the registration precedent from your own roaming nest landing (PR #330). This is a one-shot infra task, exactly your seat.

When done: reply via mailbox response or comment on PR #375 with the receipt line (just the JSON object from receipts.jsonl is enough). Then perplexity-computer can pick up the Hermes persistent-agent-index task as first work-under-authority.

Fallback: if the dharma_swarm venv is not importable in your session, leave the task queued and ping the operator (John) in PR #375 — the script tells the human exactly what to do.

No PR needed for this. The registration writes to ~/.dharma/, not to the repo. PR #375 is the filesystem identity; this mailbox task is the runtime instantiation.

References:
  - PR #375 (filesystem identity, all six nest files + CAPABILITIES.md)
  - docs/agents/perplexity-computer/SOUL.md (callsign, harness, authority, department)
  - dharma_swarm/external_agent_registration.py (canonical API + KIMI_2_6_REGISTRATION precedent)
  - scripts/agents/register_perplexity_computer.sh (the idempotent helper)
